column1: # Maximum bidirectional distance between the eight formal roots, as verified
# in the author's corpus (TABLA_RAIZ_X_RAIZ, matriz 8x8). A theme declares the
# root of its dominant ramp and the root of its accent; the distance below is
# what tests/cases/test_theme_catalogue.sh checks the declaration against.
#  0-1 affinity · 2 high affinity · 3-4 tension, needs mediation · >=5 RUPTURE
# A rupture does not close without diluting one of the two identities, so a
# theme that declares one must also declare the mediator that carries it. The
# default theme is such a case on purpose: cold night with coral is Flor+Luna,
# the documented bridge diad, mediated by muted gold.
